description: This PHP script is part of the vtiger CRM project and is responsible for rendering the 'Create Email Template' page in the Settings module. It loads necessary dependencies, sets up localization variables, prepares template variables, and displays the corresponding Smarty template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used to assign variables and display templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders a Smarty template specified by filename, in this case 'CreateEmailTemplate.tpl'.
